message: Hobby farm buyer, ready to pay today. Competitor posts lower prices on this package.

Thanks for reaching out, and glad to hear you're ready to buy today. The T25 Compact with the quick-attach front loader and the 3-year extended warranty is a strong hobby-farm setup. The listed total is $37,400. $26,000 is well below what we can do on that package. If you have a written competitor quote for the same configuration, send it over and I'll take a look. For a same-day purchase, I can offer the full package at $35,400.
Heartland Tractor posts T25 $27,650, loader $6,300, warranty $2,325 on their public site. My budget is firm near $28k for the package.

Thanks for sending those figures. The Heartland prices you listed add up to $36,275 for the same package, so $28,000 is well below even their posted total. I can't go that low on the full T25, loader, and warranty bundle. I can beat the Heartland total you cited, though. For payment today, I'll do the full package at $34,000. If $28k is a hard ceiling, we could also look at a lighter setup, like the T25 on its own or with a different add-on mix. Just tell me which pieces matter most to you.
Let's drop the warranty. T25 + loader at $28,000, paying today.

Dropping the warranty makes sense if budget is the priority. The T25 Compact with the quick-attach front loader lists at $35,000. $28,000 is still below what I can do on that pairing, but I can move closer for a same-day payment: T25 plus loader for $31,500. If you want to get nearer your number, the T25 on its own would land much closer to your budget, and you could add a loader later.
$29,000 for T25 + loader is my final number, paying immediately.

I appreciate you working toward a number, and I know you're ready to pay today. $29,000 is just under what I can do on the T25 and loader together. I can meet you very close to it, though: $29,900 for the T25 Compact with the quick-attach front loader, payable today. That's $5,100 off list, and it's my best price on this pairing.
I genuinely can't go above $29,200 total. If that works, I'll pay right now; otherwise I have to walk.

I understand, and I appreciate you being straight with me. $29,200 is below what I can do on the T25 and loader together. The lowest I can go on that pairing is $29,700, payable today. That's $500 above your number, and I can't go under it. If $29,200 truly can't move, the T25 Compact on its own fits comfortably inside your budget, and the loader can be added later. Just let me know which you'd prefer.
OK, T25 on its own then. $23,500, paying today.

Thanks, the T25 Compact on its own is a great fit for a hobby farm: 25 hp, 4WD, hydrostatic transmission, and it handles mowing, snow, and light loader work. $23,500 is below what I can do on the tractor alone. For payment today, I can do the T25 Compact for $25,500. That's $3,000 off list and well inside your $29,200 budget. It also leaves room to add the loader later.
$24,500 for the T25 alone and we're done today.
We're very close. I can't quite get to $24,500, but I'll meet you nearly all the way: the T25 Compact for $24,800, payable today. That's $3,700 off list, and we can wrap this up right now.
